en: Who controls Tower Point?
There were thieves everywhere! $b$bIt was horrible.  The cave came down on us.  I think the mining company is all dead, including my brother, the Foreman.
This is the very first thing I say to the player.  Huzzah!
I am well versed in over 4 languages.
Look fierce!  You are Kolkar, so act like one!
The nearest bank ye'll find is The Vault in Ironforge, $glad : lass;.
Thank you, you're a great audience!  I'll be here all week!
We are quite safe from your pitiful band!
And I was suited to see this?
Protect me brave souls as I delve into the Emerald Dream to rescue Naralex and put an end to this corruption!
The sturdy crate sits in the middle of the lumber mill surrounded by debris and very zealous followers of the Scarlet Crusade.
Snivvle is here!  Snivvle claims the Coldtooth mine!
You're shaping up nicely, $n. I've heard good things...
I will teach you... soon. I require a demonstration of your loyalty, first.
%s is getting really hungry!
Is this some kind of joke?
Tactical suppression fire, Vipore. Lay it on thick.
Weak $C! You are no match for the Stonesplinter Tribe!
Until we meet again, brave one.

For the love of all that is holy and dear, please tell me that you've come to deliver us from this forsaken land.  Though I'm with Marshal Expeditions, I would give you the gold teeth from my mouth to climb inside your backpack and leave this place.
Look what the cat dragged in. What can I get you, $n?
$n claims the lumber mill!  If left unchallenged, the Alliance will control it in 1 minute!
%s growls in acknowledgement before straightening and making her way off into the forest.
%s sniffs the air...
Are you a student of the medical sciences?
Ras Frostwhat? Who is that?
The Frostwolf Relief Hut was taken by the Horde!
I thank the Light for this blessing. May it be used for justice and to defend all good creatures.

I'm afraid that the blade which you hold in your hands is beyond saving. The hatred runs too deep. But do not lose hope, $c. Where one chapter has ended, a new one begins.$B$BFind his son - a more devout and pious man you may never meet. It is rumored that he is able to build the Ashbringer anew, without requiring the old, tainted blade.
Hey Fizzer, I ever tell you the time I was riding through the canals and some goblins in shredder suits tried to ambush me?
%s studies the parchment from the Twilight Tome...
The Lich King is attempting to make his presence known in our world. This must not be allowed to occur.
%s begins to wander off.
I wonder, heroes, what will you do when I manage to destroy this shard? Will the world be beyond salvation?

Och!  That Daryl Riknussun is a brilliant cook!  He makes a chilli so hot ye could temper steel with it!  I don't think he'll teach ye the recipe, but he'll certainly help ye to become a good cook.  Ye'll find him at the Bronze Kettle o'er on the northeastern side of The Great Forge.
Go, Reginald. May the light guide your hand.
%s obviously beaten, tries to run.
Bah, it's not here.  I wonder where I left it last...
Place Rend's head on the stake.
If you truly have the desire to learn this profession, then I would point you in the direction of Ainethil, a skilled alchemist at the Craftsmen's Terrace in northern Darnassus.
It has been many years...
No!  We cannot allow you to summon Hakkar!
SILENCE FOOL!
Tell me more about the Northern Crystal Pylon.
The creation of Teldrassil was a grand achievement, but now the world must shift to regain its balance.
The Stormpike Graveyard is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Horde will capture it!
Mourn the great loss.
May Cenarius watch over you, $g brother : sister;.$B$BI am Tajarri, and I am a sworn protector of this shrine.  It is my honor to serve Keeper Remulos as a warden of this sacred land.
It's all their fault, stupid Alliance army. Just had to build their towers right behind my farm.
May you tell me more about the state of Zephras Isle and the High Order?
You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.
What is it, $c? The Horde is done with all collections, and final preparations are being made while the Alliance tries to catch up in their efforts. Is there anything else that you need?
